legalActions.narration: Five cards dealt each. Discard a card matching suit or rank, or an 8 as wild.

instructions: Match the top discard card by rank or suit. 8s can be played anytime as wildcards. If you have no legal play, draw from the stock or pass your turn. The first player to shed all cards wins.
